rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for a writer and creator of theatrical plays.

example.english: This playwright's new play will premiere at the theatre next month.
example.traditional: 呢位劇作家嘅新戲下個月喺劇院公演。
example.jyutping: nei1 wai6 kek6 zok3 gaa1 ge3 san1 hei3 haa6 go3 jyut6 hai2 kek6 jyun2 gung1 jin2

rows.note: Use this when focusing on someone who writes the script, especially when the production may be a film, television programme, or stage play.

example.english: They are the playwright for the TV drama and often have to revise the script.
example.traditional: 佢係套電視劇嘅編劇，成日要改劇本。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai6 tou3 din6 si6 kek6 ge3 pin1 kek6 seng4 jat6 jiu3 goi2 kek6 bun2
